subject: af-con
title: AF.CON.------CUL.SOLD.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 142 (UPB(II)-4). AF-CON (affinity convergence) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". The title names CUL-SOLD; the chart has no label for it. From the subject: CULT-SOLD (culture solidification), C-CULT-AT (composite culture attitude) and TRS (transition). From C-CULT-AT: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From TRS: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and PROG-SIGN (progressional significance). From T-C-IMP: CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions). From CRTF-D: EXP-CONT (expansion condition) and MT-IMP (multi-implications). From MT-IMP: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics).
